title: Advance Hidden for Customer
description: Only dispatchers and admins move freight along its route — a customer or driver watching their own shipment shouldn't see a button suggesting they can do that themselves.
successCondition: Logged in as a customer or a driver, the tracking table renders with no "Actions" column header and no "Advance" button anywhere in the table; logged in as a dispatcher or admin, the same table does render an "Actions" column with an "Advance" button per row.
hints: canAdvance in TrackingDashboard.tsx gates both the column header and the button cells together — a partial bug might show the header without buttons or vice versa, so check both.
This is purely a rendering check — separately, the API also enforces this server-side, but that's not what this challenge is testing.
